resultados.pregunta: ¿Qué 5 categorías de producto (con nombre de categoría) tienen mayor proporción de clientes que les compraron una sola vez, entre las categorías con al menos 500 pedidos válidos (sin contar pedidos cancelados o no disponibles)?
resultados.sql_generado:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS categoria,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS clientes_unicos,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id), 2) AS proporción
FROM 
  products p
  LEFT JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE 
  o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') 
  AND oi.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM vw_pedidos_validos)
  AND p.product_category_name IN (
    SELECT 
      COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) 
    FROM 
      products p
      LEFT JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
    GROUP BY 
      categoria
    HAVING 
      COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) >= 500
  )
GROUP BY 
  categoria
ORDER BY
